elements.description:
Test cases run against prompt or model versions – pass or fail per case per version, the pass rate across versions,
filters by tag, and a case opened beside its expected answer.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading – the eval set's name

properties.name: versions
properties.description: The versions in the order they were made – the last one is judged by the Failing and Regressed filters

properties.name: cases
properties.description: The test cases, each with its results per version

properties.name: tags
properties.description: The picked tags – a case with any of them shows; none picked shows every case

properties.name: show
properties.description: Which cases show: "all", "failing" (on the latest version) or "regressed" (passed on the one before, fails now)

properties.name: open
properties.description: The open case and version, or null for none

properties.name: maxHeight
properties.description: The grid's height before it scrolls, in px

properties.name: formatRate
properties.description: Formats a pass rate (0–1) – defaults to a whole percentage, e.g. "86%"

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-tags-change
events.description: The picked tags changed ({ tags }: EvalScorecardTagsChange); cancelable

events.name: tc-show-change
events.description: All, Failing or Regressed was picked ({ show }: EvalScorecardShowChange); cancelable

events.name: tc-open-change
events.description: A case was opened, switched to another version or closed ({ open }: EvalScorecardOpenChange); cancelable

functions.name: evalStats
functions.signature: evalStats(versions: EvalVersion[], cases: readonly EvalCase[]): EvalVersionStats[]
functions.description: Pass rate per version over a set of cases: passes over everything that finished; null when nothing has

functions.name: evalRegressed
functions.description: Whether a case failed on the latest version after passing on the one before

props.name: title
props.description: The heading – the eval set's name

props.name: tags
props.description: The picked tags. Controlled when defined; otherwise the component keeps them, starting from `defaultTags`

props.name: defaultTags
props.description: The tags picked at first when `tags` isn't controlled

props.name: onTagsChange
props.description: Called with the picked tags after a tag is toggled or cleared, controlled or not

props.name: show
props.description: Which cases show – "all", "failing" or "regressed". Controlled when defined

props.name: defaultShow
props.description: Which cases show at first when `show` isn't controlled

props.name: onShowChange
props.description: Called with the outcome filter the user picked, controlled or not

props.name: open
props.description: The open case and version, or null. Controlled when defined

props.name: defaultOpen
props.description: The case open at first when `open` isn't controlled

props.name: onOpenChange
props.description: Called when a case is opened, switched to another version or closed, controlled or not
